name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A modal panel that slides in from an edge of the window over a scrim, on Base UI's Dialog: right, left, top or bottom, three widths, a header, a scrolling body, a pinned footer and a close button.
usage: Use Sheet for a form or a detail view that belongs beside the page rather than in front of it: edit a connection, a cell's full value, filters. Compose it as Sheet > SheetTrigger (render a Button; or open it through open) + SheetContent > SheetHeader (SheetTitle, SheetDescription), SheetBody (the Fields; it scrolls), SheetFooter (SheetClose rendering a Button, then the primary action). side picks the edge (right by default) and size the width of a left or right sheet; a top or bottom sheet spans the window and is as tall as its content. Every sheet needs a SheetTitle. For a short task in the middle of the screen use Dialog; for a decision use AlertDialog; for a sidebar that stays open next to the content use Sidebar.

props.name: side
props.description: The edge the sheet slides in from.

props.name: size
props.description: The width of a left or right sheet, from size.panel.* (320, 448, 576 px); ignored for top and bottom.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger, a SheetClose, Escape or a click on the scrim opens or closes it.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Keeps the sheet open on a click outside it (a form with unsaved input).

props.name: showClose
props.description: SheetContent: shows the close button in the top corner.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: SheetContent: the accessible name of the close button.

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: backdrop
slots.description: The scrim, color.bg.scrim at z.overlay; data-slot="sheet-backdrop".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: role="dialog" at z.modal, color.bg.overlay with elevation.modal and a border on its inner edge, with the region's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="sheet-content", data-side, data-size.

parts.name: SheetTrigger
parts.description: Opens the sheet; unstyled, render a Button through render.

parts.name: SheetContent
parts.description: The portal with the scrim and the sheet, plus a close IconButton unless showClose is false.

parts.name: SheetHeader
parts.description: The title and description, stacked, leaving room for the close button.

parts.name: SheetTitle
parts.description: An <h2> in type.heading-4 that names the sheet.

parts.name: SheetDescription
parts.description:
A

in color.fg.muted that describes the sheet.

parts.name: SheetBody
parts.description: The content; takes the free height and scrolls.

parts.name: SheetFooter
parts.description: The actions, pinned at the bottom of the sheet.

parts.name: SheetClose
parts.description: Closes the sheet; unstyled, render a Button through render.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: the sheet slides in from its edge over motion.duration.slow with motion.easing.emphasized and the scrim fades in; reduced motion turns the slide off.

states.name: closing
states.description: Closing: it slides back out with motion.easing.exit.

accessibility: The sheet is role="dialog", named by SheetTitle and described by SheetDescription; while it is open the page behind is inert and hidden from assistive technology.
Opening moves focus into the sheet; Tab stays inside; Escape or a press on the scrim closes it and focus returns to the trigger.
The close button is an IconButton with an accessible name and a visible focus ring.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the slide off (motion-reduce:transition-none); the sheet appears in place.
The sheet takes the theme and density of the region it is declared in.
